objections.claim: The Node support contract is internally inconsistent. The installation contract and manifest oracle admit Node >=22.12.0, but the no-listener guarantee requires disabling SIGUSR1 inspector activation; Node’s concrete `--disable-sigusr1` control was added only in v22.14.0. The approach explicitly makes doctor refuse `inspector-uncontainable` where no equivalent exists, so conforming 22.12.x/22.13.x installations can never become usable despite satisfying the documented requirement. Raise the product/engines/install minimum to >=22.14.0, or specify and regression-test a real equivalent containment mechanism for 22.12.x–22.13.x.
